cleaner.label: npm and npx
cleaner.description: Package cache, temporary npx runs and npm logs; does not touch projects or node_modules.

option.label: npm package cache
option.description: Removes the npm cache. Close Node/npm; packages will have to be downloaded again.

option.label: Temporary npx installs
option.description: Removes only the temporary copies of npx packages.
option.warning: Future npx runs may re-download packages. Do not use while npx is running.

option.label: npm logs
option.description: Removes npm debug logs. Keeps any logs needed to diagnose recent errors.

option.label: npm cache in a custom folder
option.description: Removes the package cache, temporary npx copies and logs in the folder set by the npm_config_cache variable. Appears only if the variable is defined.
option.warning: Packages will have to be downloaded again and future npx runs may re-download packages. Do not use while npm or npx is running.
